simple.meaning: חֹרֵשׁ (chôrêsh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a fabricator or mechanic.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Genesis, 1 Kings, beginning at Genesis 4:22. The surrounding contexts include birth, family, family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֹרֵשׁ (H2794) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חֹרֵשׁ (chôrêsh) / H2794 is traced through Genesis 4:22, 1 Kings 7:14 with source-language evidence and verse context.

occurrences.englishText: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill, to work all works in bronze. He came to king Solomon, and performed all his work.
